20f3d07d3c47.scene: A Highveld afternoon thunderstorm, the sky outside dark as night, seen from inside a lounge, camera at floor level. A dog lying flat under the dining table in the middle of the frame, head on its paws, eyes open. Behind it the window lit white by lightning, rain streaking the glass, curtains half drawn, a TV standby light. The top of the frame is dark ceiling and the lit window; no people.
20f3d07d3c47.weather: A thunderstorm outside: dark storm cloud, heavy rain and lightning beyond the glass; indoors is dry and calm; nothing broken.
20f3d07d3c47.note: Camera at floor level and pulled well back; the dog lies in the vertical middle of the frame; the top 40% of the frame is ceiling and window with no person and no face in it. No person anywhere in the frame.

87546db18e01.scene: A backyard pool on a hot night, camera at water level at the pool's edge. Only two people, sitting side by side on the far edge of the pool, shown from the chest down: their legs and feet dangling in the water fill the middle of the frame. Fairy lights and a braai's orange glow reflected on the surface, a floating pool noodle. No one else anywhere in the frame; the braai itself is out of shot, only its orange glow on the water. The top of the frame is the dark sky and the string lights.
87546db18e01.weather: A hot summer night: warm, still air; people cooling their legs in the water.
87546db18e01.note: Camera at water level; the two people are cut off at the chest, so no head and no face is in the frame at all; the top 40% of the frame is dark sky and string lights only, with no person in it.

fbaca052756a.scene: A cold, rainy day indoors, curtains half drawn and the lounge dim, rain streaking the window, camera at carpet level. A blanket fort draped over two dining chairs in the middle of the frame, a torch glowing through the blanket from inside, a child's socked feet sticking out of the entrance, a bar heater's orange glow at the edge, a mug on the carpet. No faces anywhere. The top of the frame is the dim ceiling and the top of the fort.
fbaca052756a.weather: Steady rain is falling outside, streaking the window; grey, dim daylight indoors.
fbaca052756a.note: Camera at carpet level and pulled back; the fort sits in the vertical middle of the frame; the top 40% of the frame is dim ceiling and the top of the fort. No face anywhere in the frame; only the child's socked feet show.
